name: typesafe-jev
description: Typed judgments from TypeSafe's Jev model: send text or JSON state plus Noul (yes-probability), Choice (one of a set, with a distribution) or Score (position on ordered levels) questions and get back probabilities code can consume; pinned model, code ceilings on state and question size, a credential-file egress guard, and an audit line per paid call
hits: TypeSafe API (api.typesafe.ai; paid per input token, the operator's own key)
surface: CLI only. `models` lists the names the key may send (free); `ask` POSTs one evaluation to /v1/systemone under code ceilings (96 KB state, 200 KB request, 32 questions, 255 options, 2–10 levels) with the model pinned to jev-1.13.0; `--explain` shows the request and its estimated cost without calling; `usage` totals the local audit log. No write exists on the service

origin.note: Written in the belt from the TypeSafe docs (https://docs.typesafe.ai/api.md, /models.md) and the vendor agent skill (github.com/typesafe-ai/skills, skills/typesafe-ai/SKILL.md), checked live against api.typesafe.ai on 2026-09-27. Zero dependencies: plain fetch, not @typesafe-ai/sdk. The vendor's `claude plugin install typesafe@typesafe-ai` / `npx skills add` step is not taken: the belt has one router skill and this CLAUDE.md is the contract

env.name: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
env.description: Your TypeSafe API key, billed per input token to your own account; the name the official SDKs read. Alternatives: ~/.config/toolbelt/typesafe-jev.key or tools/typesafe-jev/.env (gitignored), both mode 600. Not needed for --explain or usage

auth.flow: A static API key from the operator's own TypeSafe account, billed to it; read from $TYPESAFE_API_KEY, else a 600-mode key file outside the tree, else the gitignored tools/typesafe-jev/.env; sent only as the Bearer header, never printed, logged or placed on argv
auth.login: Create a key in your TypeSafe account, then either export TYPESAFE_API_KEY, or: mkdir -p ~/.config/toolbelt && umask 077 && printf '%s\n' '<key>' > ~/.config/toolbelt/typesafe-jev.key

caches.note: optional 600-mode key file; resolveKey() in jev.mjs refuses a group/world-readable one
caches.revoke: Revoke the key in the TypeSafe account, then rm ~/.config/toolbelt/typesafe-jev.key

caches.note: in-tree fallback the operator chose; gitignored by tools/typesafe-jev/.gitignore, refused unless mode 600; the your_… template value counts as absent
caches.revoke: Revoke the key in the TypeSafe account, then remove the line from tools/typesafe-jev/.env

safeguards: Read-only on the service: /v1/systemone evaluates and /v1/models lists; the API has no mutation and jev ships no other call (SENSIBILITIES #1)

Ceilings are code constants in jev.mjs that no flag raises: MAX_STATE_BYTES 96000, MAX_REQUEST_BYTES 200000, MAX_QUESTIONS 32, MAX_OPTIONS 255, 2–10 Score levels; a request over one exits 2 before anything is sent. A one-level Score, which the API accepts and bills, is refused (SENSIBILITIES #3)
The model is pinned to jev-1.13.0 so an alias move cannot shift tuned thresholds; --model is the explicit override (SENSIBILITIES #3)

--explain prints the endpoint, the question ids and types, state and request bytes against their ceilings, an estimated token count and cost, and whether a key was found — with the state summarized and the key redacted — and makes no call (SENSIBILITIES #5)

Egress guard: a --state file is sent only after resolving symlinks and refusing credential-shaped names (.env*, *.key, *.pem, id_*, .netrc, .npmrc, credentials) and anything under ~/.ssh, ~/.gnupg, ~/.aws or ~/.config/toolbelt (assertStatePath in jev.mjs)

Audit line per call on stderr, and per ask appended to ~/.local/share/typesafe-jev/audit.log (dir 700, file 600): timestamp, verb, status, answering model, question ids, state bytes, input tokens, cost — never the key, the state, the questions or the answers (SENSIBILITIES #7)

30 s timeout per request; 408/429/5xx retry at most 3 attempts with backoff honoring retry-after-ms / Retry-After (capped at 30 s); 401, 403, 400 and 422 each end with a plain sentence and exit 1 (SENSIBILITIES #8)
The key comes from $TYPESAFE_API_KEY, ~/.config/toolbelt/typesafe-jev.key or the gitignored tools/typesafe-jev/.env; a group/world-readable file is refused (SENSIBILITIES #11)
The tiers are a table in the code (VERBS in jev.mjs) and the test suite asserts this manifest's verbs[] matches it

verbs.name: models
verbs.note: GET /v1/models — the names the key may send in `model` (today the jev-latest and jev-preview aliases); runs no inference, reports no usage

verbs.name: ask
verbs.note: POST /v1/systemone — one evaluation of Noul/Choice/Score questions over text or JSON state; $0.042 per million input tokens (≈$0.00002 for a short message), output free; --explain first shows the estimate

verbs.name: usage
verbs.note: totals calls, input tokens and cost from the local audit.log; no network

verbs.name: batch / fan-out over a directory
verbs.note: no verb exists; a caller loops over `ask` itself, and each call is audited

risk.worst_case: sends up to 200 KB of operator-named text to TypeSafe per call (not trained on; retention per their DPA) and spends ≈$0.002 of the operator's own credit at the ceiling, each call audited with its actual token count

systems.name: TypeSafe Jev (typed AI judgments: classify, route, score, verify)

checks.name: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
checks.label: TypeSafe API key present ($TYPESAFE_API_KEY or a 600-mode ~/.config/toolbelt/typesafe-jev.key)
checks.fix: Create a key in your TypeSafe account, then export TYPESAFE_API_KEY=… or write it to ~/.config/toolbelt/typesafe-jev.key (chmod 600)

checks.label: TypeSafe accepts the key (GET /v1/models, no inference)

smoke_test.command: node jev.mjs ask --text 'smoke test' --noul 'Is this a test?' --explain | grep -q 'no call made' && node --test test/*.test.mjs
smoke_test.expect: the pre-flight renders without calling TypeSafe; unit tests green — key precedence and mode refusal, schema validation and ceilings, the egress guard, audit-line contents, usage totals, retry delays, manifest/VERBS parity
